business_problem: Eka Care needed to reduce the clinical time lost to administrative work, structure large volumes of unstructured medical data, and preserve compliance while scaling digital healthcare services for doctors and patients across India.
solution_summary: Eka Care built AI-driven healthcare workflows on AWS to turn unstructured clinical interactions into usable patient context for doctors and patients. Its Eka Doc, DocAssist, and Voice2RX experiences use Amazon Bedrock to power generative-AI features that support decision-making and automation, while Amazon Transcribe converts doctor-patient conversations into structured notes for prescriptions and follow-up care. These capabilities sit alongside Eka Care's personal health record application so patient data, prescriptions, and administrative workflows can be handled through a single digital experience. By combining transcription, generative AI, and real-time analytics on patient information, the platform helps doctors move faster inside high-volume practices while maintaining HIPAA-aligned and India DPDP-aligned handling of sensitive health data. The result is more time with patients and broader access to digital health records and care support.

data_flow: Doctor-patient conversations are captured and transcribed by Amazon Transcribe, then Amazon Bedrock-based applications use the resulting medical context to generate structured notes, support clinical decisions, and surface patient insights inside Eka Care's doctor and personal-health-record workflows.
business_outcome: Eka Care gives doctors more time with patients, improves access to personal health data for patients, and creates a scalable path to better health outcomes for millions across India by automating documentation and real-time insight generation.
architecture_clues: Uses HIPAA-compliant AWS services and aligns with India's DPDP Act guidelines.
